title: Brooklyn Auto Group — gatekeeper → Dan → 'we have a broker' → booked

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Brooklyn Auto Group, this is Maria.

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Hi Maria, Alex Chen with Harbor Insurance calling for Dan. Is he in?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: The March renewal, Dan will know. Is he available?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Can you just send an email to info@brooklynauto.com?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Will do. What time is Dan usually free? I'll call back then instead.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hold on, let me see if he's free.

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Dan, Alex Chen with Harbor Insurance. I'll be brief, got twenty seconds?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Your policy renews in March. A second set of eyes before then, worth fifteen minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We're all set, we have a broker.

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Keep them. A second look before March costs you nothing. Fifteen minutes?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Tuesday at 10, fifteen minutes. What's the best email for the invite?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Invite's on its way. Thanks Dan, talk Tuesday.
